findingDetails.title: Hub NEVER rule forbids the packet-local ROUTER.md that three packets already carry and the gate requires
findingDetails.case: A maintainer reads SKILL.md:87 as authoritative and removes sk-product-owner/ROUTER.md to comply; the packet loses its ## 3 machine router block, check_hub.py fails, and the hub's ROUTER.md:46/:67 pointers dangle.
findingDetails.scopeProof: SKILL.md:87 is in the reviewed hub; all four corroborating files were read on disk this iteration.
findingDetails.claim: SKILL.md:87 absolutely forbids a packet-local ROUTER.md, while three packets carry one and check_hub.py requires that shape for packets that have it.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether the NEVER targets a second or redundant router, whether the packet ROUTER.md files are legacy or generated, and whether SKILL.md scopes the rule to new files. No exception clause exists; SKILL.md:82 addresses only SKILL.md Section 2 routing.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The NEVER intends 'do not add a router where the packet already routes in its SKILL.md Section 2', and the three packets are the exception the sentence failed to write.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade to P2 if the upstream sk-create-skill parent-hub contract states a conditional clause making the sibling ROUTER.md the supported shape for packets that declare one, so SKILL.md:87 is merely a truncated quotation of a rule the gate follows correctly.

findingDetails.title: scripts/ is claimed as a declared repo-root-hub path but is absent from repoPaths
findingDetails.case: A checker enumerating hub repo entries from repoPaths reports scripts/ as undeclared skill-like content, or a maintainer trusts the layout block and assumes scripts/ is already skipped.
findingDetails.scopeProof: repoPaths read from mode-registry.json:35-50; scripts/ confirmed present and enumerated on disk.

findingDetails.title: ROUTER.md names a parser script that does not exist anywhere in the repository
findingDetails.case: A maintainer changing a RESOURCE_MAP row runs the named parser to confirm canonical dual-read, gets MODULE_NOT_FOUND, and either skips the check or hand-audits the map.
findingDetails.scopeProof: leaf-route-replay searched repository-wide this iteration (zero hits); the two sibling lib scripts probed and resolve.

findingDetails.title: The INSTALL-GUIDE.md exclusion is justified by a ROOT_RESOURCES array the vendored packet does not have
findingDetails.case: An install-route reader looks for ROOT_RESOURCES to confirm the guide loads outside the leaf contract and finds only a flat reference link, so the exclusion and the leaf-manifest shape look arbitrary.
findingDetails.scopeProof: ROOT_RESOURCES and rootResources grepped in mcp-click-up/SKILL.md and mcp-figma/SKILL.md (zero hits); INSTALL-GUIDE grepped in mcp-click-up/SKILL.md (one hit, line 302).
